text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe delivered a great run in her 
debut race. Her "connection" with the 
other Umamusume was also a success. 
Meanwhile, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the race originally planned for entry, 
Air Groove's junior disciple had achieved 
an overwhelming victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe must have foreseen this from 
the entry sheet and advised him to avoid 
it. The Trainer hadn't realized in time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I need to deepen my understanding of her 
thoughts. Thus, the Trainer aimed to 
"synchronize" by having her run multiple 
races throughout the year.
